svg.title: Colorado Traffic Tracker technology stack
svg.desc: Backend: Java 21 and Spring Boot. Storage: PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB and Flyway. Dashboard: JavaScript, Canvas and MapLibre GL JS. Testing: JUnit, PIT mutation testing and Playwright browser tests. Build and deployment: Maven, GitHub Actions, Docker Compose and Caddy.
